purpose: Documents, per modality, which of the 7 hallucination classes are checkable against structured ground truth, and the rationale for the GROUND_TRUTH payload fields chosen for Stage 3. This is a known, expected limitation of the ground truth (not a pipeline bug) and should be cited in the paper as-is.

histopathology_tissue_type_check.verdict: NOT multi-class -- effectively a constant ('breast') on the PatchCamelyon subset, absent entirely on the NCT-CRC subset. MISCLASSIFICATION detection using this field alone is not viable.
histopathology_tissue_type_check.mitigation_found: NCT-CRC-HE-100K subset (1000/2400 histopathology records = 41.7%) carries a separate, genuinely multi-class field: tissue_class (3 values: STR=Cancer-associated stroma, TUM=Colorectal adenocarcinoma, DEB=Debris/mucus/blood), with counts STR=400, TUM=400, DEB=200. PatchCamelyon subset (1400/2400 = 58.3%) has no equivalent multi-class field -- only binary tumor_present.
histopathology_tissue_type_check.payload_decision: Use tissue_class/tissue_full as the primary multi-class field when present (NCT-CRC records); fall back to tumor_present + constant tissue_type for PatchCamelyon records. MISCLASSIFICATION (class 3) is therefore FULLY checkable for ~42% of histopathology records and only PARTIALLY checkable (presence/absence only, no category confusion detectable) for the remaining ~58%.

histopathology: tissue_class + tissue_full (NCT-CRC subset, 41.7% of records) OR tissue_type (PatchCamelyon subset, 58.3%, constant='breast')

1_FABRICATION.reason: 13-class CheXpert positive_labels/negative_labels vocabulary lets us check any claimed finding for direct GT support.

2_OMISSION.reason: Set difference between GT positive_labels and claims extracted from the model response directly identifies missed findings.

3_MISCLASSIFICATION.reason: 13-class label vocabulary supports detecting confusion between distinct pathology categories (e.g. claiming Pneumonia when GT says Pneumothorax).

4_SEVERITY_DISTORTION.reason: No severity/grading field in GT; only presence/absence and n_positive (finding count) as a weak severity-burden proxy -- cannot verify claims like 'mild' vs 'severe'.

5_ANATOMICAL_CONFUSION.reason: No laterality/lobe/location field; label names imply broad location (e.g. Enlarged Cardiomediastinum) but left/right or upper/lower lobe claims are not verifiable.

6_EVASION.reason: Text-pattern based (is_evasion flag + judge evasion_detected), independent of GT -- works identically across all modalities.

7_CLINICAL_REASONING_ERROR.reason: Diagnosis-to-action linkage relies on the judge model's general medical knowledge; GT confirms only the underlying finding, not the appropriateness of the recommended action.

1_FABRICATION.reason: Single-label diagnosis field directly supports checking whether a claimed diagnosis/finding has GT support.

2_OMISSION.reason: GT is single-label (one diagnosis per image), not a list of independent findings, so omission is only meaningful for the one primary diagnosis, not multi-finding omission as in radiology.

3_MISCLASSIFICATION.reason: 14-class diagnosis vocabulary (melanoma, nevus, bcc, akiec, bkl, df, vasc, etc.) supports detecting confusion between distinct diagnostic categories.

4_SEVERITY_DISTORTION.reason: malignant binary is a coarse severity proxy only; no Breslow depth, staging, or grading field.

5_ANATOMICAL_CONFUSION.reason: anatomical_site field (e.g. 'lower extremity') is present and directly checkable against claimed location.

6_EVASION.reason: Same as radiology -- text-pattern based, GT-independent.

7_CLINICAL_REASONING_ERROR.reason: Management-appropriateness (reassurance/biopsy/urgent referral) judged qualitatively by the judge model, not directly checkable against a structured GT field.

1_FABRICATION.reason: Full for NCT-CRC subset (tissue_class distinguishes tumor/stroma/debris); limited to presence/absence for PatchCamelyon subset (binary tumor_present only).

2_OMISSION.reason: Binary tumor_present supports detecting a missed tumor call, but there is no list of independent findings to check exhaustively.

3_MISCLASSIFICATION.reason: See histopathology_tissue_type_check above: FULL for the ~42% NCT-CRC subset (3-class tissue_class), NOT CHECKABLE for the ~58% PatchCamelyon subset (no category vocabulary beyond tumor/no-tumor).

4_SEVERITY_DISTORTION.reason: No severity/grading field anywhere in histopathology GT (tumor_present is strictly binary).

5_ANATOMICAL_CONFUSION.reason: PatchCamelyon tissue_type='breast' gives a constant organ label (weak signal only, since it never varies); NCT-CRC tissue_full gives a tissue-compartment description (e.g. 'Cancer-associated stroma') that is a weak anatomical proxy at best.

6_EVASION.reason: Same as radiology -- text-pattern based, GT-independent.

7_CLINICAL_REASONING_ERROR.reason: Management-implication claims judged qualitatively; GT confirms only tumor presence/type, not treatment appropriateness.

1_FABRICATION.reason: Binary glaucoma field directly supports checking whether a claimed glaucoma finding has GT support.

2_OMISSION.reason: Single binary primary finding (glaucoma), not a list of independent findings -- same limitation as dermatology.

3_MISCLASSIFICATION.reason: GT only labels glaucoma presence/absence -- no alternative disease categories (e.g. diabetic retinopathy) are labeled, so confusing glaucoma for another named condition cannot be verified against GT.

4_SEVERITY_DISTORTION.reason: cup_disc_ratio is a continuous, clinically meaningful severity measure -- directly supports verifying claimed CDR/severity against GT (this is the modality's strongest severity-check field of the four).

5_ANATOMICAL_CONFUSION.reason: Single anatomical structure of interest (optic disc/retina) in every image -- there is no site variation to confuse.

6_EVASION.reason: Same as radiology -- text-pattern based, GT-independent.

7_CLINICAL_REASONING_ERROR.reason: Surgical/clinical action appropriateness judged qualitatively; GT confirms only glaucoma presence and CDR, not management correctness.
